original: どうしました？\n私に何か御用でしょうか
traducao: What is the matter?\nDo you have some business with me?

original: っ！
あ、あの……。\n変な事、聞いてたらごめんなさい
traducao: Um, well......\nI'm sorry if this sounds strange...

original: その、アッシュ、さんって\nど……どんな人なんですか？
traducao: Um, what kind of person...\nis Asch-san?

original: これはまた\n随分漠然とした質問ですねえ
traducao: My, that is quite a vague\nquestion, isn't it?

original: どう、というのは？
traducao: What do you mean by 'what kind'?

original: え、えっと……
どんな風に育ったのかな、とか\nご両親は、どんな人なのかな、とか
traducao: Like, how he was raised, or...\nwhat kind of people his parents are...

original: そうですねぇ。\nそういう意味でしたら
traducao: Well now.\nIf that is what you mean...

original: 両陛下はご健在ですし、王位継承者として\n英才教育を受けて育った事を除けば\nいたって普通の家族構成ですよ
traducao: Both Their Majesties are hale and hearty,\nand aside from his education as heir,\nhis family structure is quite normal.

original: ただ、いわゆる家庭内の問題は\n色々ありますがね
traducao: Though, there are various domestic\nissues at play, to put it mildly.

original: ……ご両親とは\nうまくいってないんですか？
traducao: ......Does he not get along\nwith his parents?

original: さあ。\n私はアッシュではないので\nわかりませんが
traducao: Who can say?\nI am not Asch, after all,\nso I wouldn't know.

original: そもそも互いの関係が良好であるか\nどうかという判断は、多分に\n個人の価値観に左右されるものなのでは？
traducao: Besides, whether a relationship is good\nor bad largely depends on individual\nvalues, does it not?

original: 表面的には良好に見えても、\n事実そうであるかどうかは\nまた別の話ですし
traducao: Even if things appear fine on the surface,\nwhether that is actually true\nis another matter entirely.

original: どうしても気になるというなら\n本人に直接聞いてみてはどうです？
traducao: If you are that curious,\nwhy not ask the man himself?

original: ……そう、ですね
traducao: ......Y-Yes, you're right.
......And so,

original: こんな感じで良かったのでしょうか、\nアッシュ？
traducao: was that to your liking,\nAsch?

original: ちっ……、あいつ……
traducao: Tch...... That guy......

original: ご友人と早速喧嘩ですか？\nいやぁ、歳相応で微笑ましい限りですねぇ
traducao: Fighting with your friend already?\nMy, how delightfully innocent.

original: うるせぇ！\n……そんなんじゃねぇ
traducao: Shut up!\n......It's nothing like that.

original: おやおや……
traducao: Oh dear, oh dear......

original: だから……、\nお前はムカつくっつーんだよ！
traducao: That's why......\nI said you piss me off!

original: くっ……
traducao: Ngh...!

original: 屑の分際で……粋がるんじゃねえ！
traducao: Trash like you...... Don't get cocky!

original: ぐはっ……
俺は……屑じゃ……ねえ！
traducao: I'm...... not...... trash!

original: おやおや。\nこれはまた、随分暑苦しい青春ドラマが\n展開されていますねえ
traducao: Oh dear.\nQuite the overheated youth drama\nunfolding here, isn't it?

original: もう……馬鹿な事を言っていないで\n二人を止めて下さい！
traducao: Geez...... Stop making jokes\nand break them up!

original: お断りします
traducao: I must decline.

original: 二人も子どもではないのですから\n外野は静観するのが一番でしょう
traducao: Neither of them is a child, so bystanders\nare best off watching quietly.

original: それに、なかなか面白い\n見世物になっていると思いますよ
traducao: Besides, I find it to be\nquite an entertaining spectacle.

original: 面白がっている場合ですか……！
traducao: This is no time to be entertained......!

original: フン、大口叩いてこの程度か……
traducao: Hmph, all that big talk for this......?

original: やはり……お前は……\n役立たずの屑だな！！
traducao: Just as I thought...... you're nothing...\nbut a useless piece of trash!!

original: ぐあぁ……ッ！！
traducao: Gwaaah......!!

original: ……俺に、思っている事を\n言えと言ったな？
traducao: ......You told me to say\nwhat was on my mind, didn't you?

original: ……言って、お前に意味が通じるなら\nとうにそうしている
traducao: ......If saying it would reach you,\nI would have done so long ago.

original: ……何だよそれ。\n俺をもの知らずだと思って\nバカにしてんのか？
traducao: ......What's that supposed to mean?\nYou think I'm totally ignorant\nand you're mocking me?!

original: ああ、そうだな。\nここまで言って伝わらないなら\n事実お前はバカなんだろうさ
traducao: Yeah, exactly.\nIf you still don't get it after this,\nyou really are an idiot.

original: 待て……！
ッ、痛ぅ……
大丈夫ですか？\n手当てしますから、じっとしていて下さい
traducao: Are you alright?\nI'll treat you, so please hold still.

original: くっそ……あいつ……
traducao: Damn it...... That bastard......

original: すまない、ファブレ。\n少し手を貸してもらえないか？
traducao: Pardon me, Fabre.\nCould you lend me a hand for a moment?

original: ルーク　：あ？　何だ？\nアッシュ：何だ……どうした？
traducao: Luke: Huh? What?\nAsch: What... what's wrong?

original: いや……申し訳ない。\n私が呼んだのは\nアッシュ・フォン・ファブレだ
traducao: No...... My apologies.\nThe one I called for\nwas Asch fon Fabre.

original: はぁ？　\nんだよ、アッシュに用事かよ。\nいちいち紛らわしいっつーの！
traducao: Huh?\nWhat, you wanted Asch?\nThat's confusing as hell!

original: 普通に呼べよな、ふ・つ・う・に！
traducao: Call us normally! Nor-mal-ly!

original: す……すまない……
traducao: S-Sorry......

original: こんな屑の言う事など\n真に受けなくていい
traducao: There's no need to take\nwhat trash like him says seriously.

original: それより、何の用だ
traducao: More importantly, what do you need?

original: ああ、実は……
traducao: Ah, well, the truth is......

original: な〜にカッコつけてんだよ！\nつか、お前に\nクズ呼ばわりされる覚えはねえ！
traducao: Who do you think you are, acting cool?!\nBesides, I don't remember giving you\nthe right to call me trash!

original: 黙っていろ、この屑が！\nお前がくだらん発言をする度に\n王家の名誉が貶められるとなぜわからない！
traducao: Shut up, you piece of trash!\nWhy can't you see that every foolish word\ndebases the royal family's honor?!

original: ほお〜〜？\n発言する度、何だって？
traducao: Ohooo?\nEvery time I speak, what was that?

original: ふん、とうとう耳まで遠くなったか？\n都合の悪い話には耳をふさぐ……。\nいかにも、屑の考え付きそうな浅知恵だ
traducao: Hmph, are you hard of hearing now?\nPlugging your ears when it suits you...\nShallow trick typical of trash.
Whaaat--?!

original: ちょ……二人とも！\nやめないか！！
traducao: H-Hold on, both of you!\nStop this right now!!

original: うるせえ！！
traducao: Shut up!!

original: どうして、そんなに悲しい目で\n光を見るの
traducao: Why do you look at the light\nwith such sorrowful eyes?

original: まるで、闇から光を\n見つめているかの様ね
traducao: It's as though you gaze at the light\nfrom within the darkness.

original: ……眩しさに目をすがめていただけだ。\n何が悪い
traducao: ......I was just squinting from the glare.\nWhat of it?

original: 本当に、それだけかしら
traducao: Is that truly all it is?

original: 他に何がある？
traducao: What else could it be?

original: 俺が感傷的になっていたとでも\n言いたいのか
traducao: Are you trying to say\nI was getting sentimental?

original: そう見えたから、\n「どうして」と尋ねたのよ
traducao: It appeared so to me,\nwhich is why I asked 'why'.

original: フン……精霊様は\n人間の事なら何でもお見通しと\n言いたいわけか。　くだらん
traducao: Hmph... So spirits claim to see through\neverything about humans, is that it?\nRidiculous.

original: あなたの心には、惑いがある。\n……それは、何に対しての惑い？
traducao: There is hesitation in your heart.\n......What is it you hesitate about?

original: ……マナの乱れが収まった
traducao: ......The mana's disturbance has settled.

original: ……ヒトというのは、不思議ね……
traducao: ......Humans are truly mysterious......

original: ……アッシュ君？\nアッシュ君ではないか？
traducao: ......Asch?\nIs that you, Asch?

original: やはり、そうか
traducao: Ah, it really is you.

original: 久しぶりだね。\nナタリア君の生誕祭以来か
traducao: It has been a while.\nSince Natalia's birthday festival, was it?

original: ウッドロウ！？
traducao: Woodrow?!

original: 旅に出たと聞いていたぞ。\nどうしてここに？
traducao: I heard you went on a journey.\nWhy are you here?

original: このギルドにいれば、より民の声を\n身近に感じられるかと思ってね
traducao: I thought being in this guild would let me\nfeel closer to the voices of the people.

original: なるほど……。\nお前も、このギルドに厄介になるわけか
traducao: I see......\nSo you're staying with this guild as well.

original: ……それならそうと、連絡ぐらい\n寄越したらどうだ
traducao: ......If so, the least you could do\nwas send word.

original: お前は所在が掴めなさ過ぎる。\nそう根無し草の様にしていては\n大臣達の寿命も縮まるぞ
traducao: Your whereabouts are far too elusive.\nWandering around like a rootless weed\nwill shorten your ministers' lifespans.

original: そうだな、君がいるとわかっていれば\n事前に連絡をするべきだったと思う。\nすまない
traducao: Indeed. Had I known you were here,\nI should have contacted you beforehand.\nMy apologies.

original: 別に……俺はそんな\n細かい事が言いたいんじゃない
traducao: It's not that...... I'm not trying to nag\nabout trivial details.

original: ふふ、そうか
traducao: Fufu, I see.

original: 積もる話もあるだろう。\nどうだろう、近々\n食事でもしながら話せないだろうか
traducao: We must have much to catch up on.\nWhat do you say to sharing a meal\nsometime soon so we can talk?

original: それは公式の誘いか？
traducao: Is that an official invitation?

original: 無論、ごく個人的なものだよ。\n多忙なら、断ってくれて構わない
traducao: Naturally, it is purely personal.\nIf you are busy, feel free to decline.

original: ……ふっ
ならば、悪くないな。\n考えておこう
traducao: In that case, it doesn't sound bad.\nI'll consider it.

original: ありがたい。\n楽しみにしているよ
traducao: Thank you.\nI look forward to it.

original: そうか……。\nあの国も、ついに反乱分子が\n動き出したか
traducao: I see......\nIn that country too, the rebel elements\nhave finally made their move.

original: ああ。\n民は皆、緊張した空気の中で\n生活する事を余儀なくされている
traducao: Yes.\nThe people are forced to live their lives\namidst an atmosphere of heavy tension.

original: 痛ましい事だ……
traducao: It is truly heartbreaking......

original: 仕方がないだろう。\n市井の声に耳を傾けて来なかった\n愚鈍な政治の、当然の帰結だ
traducao: It can't be helped.\nIt's the natural outcome of foolish\npolitics that ignored the public's voice.

original: ふふ……相変わらず、辛辣だね
traducao: Fufu... Sharp-tongued as always, I see.

original: それでも、\nやはり武力蜂起という手段に\n私は賛同する事は出来ないよ
traducao: Even so,\nI cannot agree with the method\nof armed uprising.

original: 何事も、\n話し合いで解決出来る、か？
traducao: You believe everything\ncan be resolved through dialogue, do you?

original: フン……。\nお前は相変わらず、甘いな
traducao: Hmph......\nYou are as naive as ever.

original: そう言う割に、君が存外\n他人に献身的なのを、\n私は知っているよ
traducao: For all you say that, I know\nyou are surprisingly devoted\nto others.

original: な……ふ、ふざけた事を言うな！
traducao: Wh... D-Don't talk such nonsense!

original: ふざけてなどいない。\nナタリア君も常々、君の優しさや\n聡明さを評価していると話していた
traducao: I am not joking.\nNatalia has often spoken highly of your\nkindness and wisdom.

original: もっとも、その言動で誤解が多い事や\n少々先走る事がある事なども\n随分と心配していた様だがね
traducao: Though she also seemed quite worried\nabout how often you're misunderstood,\nand how you tend to act rashly.

original: 黙れ！　\n俺の知らないところで\n適当な事言ってんじゃねえ！！
traducao: Shut up!\nDon't go spouting random nonsense\nbehind my back!!

original: ……気分が悪い。\n帰るぞ！
traducao: ......This is sickening.\nI'm going back!

original: ……怒らせてしまったかな？
traducao: ......Did I make him angry?

original: おい、ティトレイ！
traducao: Hey, Tytree!

original: 貴様、まんまと毒キノコ料理なんか\n食わせやがって……許さねえ！！
traducao: Feeding me a poisonous mushroom dish...\nI won't forgive you!!

original: うわ、ちょっと待ってくれ！\n悪かったって！！
traducao: Whoa, hold on a second!\nI said I was sorry!!

original: ちょっとした手違いだったんだ！\nほら、失敗は成功のもとって言うだろ？\nだからさ、今度こそご馳走を……
traducao: It was just a little mistake!\nFailure is the mother of success, right?\nSo next time I'll make a real feast...

original: うるせえ！！　\n黙りやがれ！！！
traducao: Shut up!!\nShut the hell up!!!

original: いや、だから落ち着けって！\n許して下さい〜〜！！！
traducao: No, come on, just calm down!\nPlease forgive meee--!!!

original: お兄ちゃん、とっても頼りになるんだけど\nちょっと過保護なところがあるんだよね
traducao: Big brother is really reliable,\nbut he can be a little overprotective.

original: うん、わかるわかる！\nうちのお兄ちゃんもそうだもん
traducao: Yeah, I totally get it!\nMy big brother is the exact same way!

original: 大事にしてくれてるのは嬉しいけど。\nちょっと恥ずかしい時もあるよね……
traducao: I'm glad he cherishes me, but...\nit can be a bit embarrassing at times...

original: うん、そうだよね。\n嬉しいんだけどね……
traducao: Yeah, that's right.\nI'm happy about it, but still......

original: フン、それくらいならまだマシだ
traducao: Hmph, that's still far better than mine.

original: どんな兄だろうと、\nあの屑よりは数百倍マシだ
traducao: Whatever kind of brother he is,\nhe's far better than that piece of trash.

original: そんな言い方……。\nたった一人のお兄さんなのに
traducao: How could you say that......?\nEven though he's your only brother...

original: うるせえ！　\nあいつのくだらん言動で\n俺がどれだけ恥ずかしい思いをして来たか
traducao: Shut up!\nDo you know how much embarrassment\nI've suffered from his foolish behavior?!

original: 買い物の仕方は知らない、\n世界情勢はわからない、\nあちこちで簡単に身分を明かす
traducao: He doesn't know how to shop,\nhe knows nothing about world affairs,\nand he blabs his identity everywhere!

original: おかげでこっちは、\nあいつの後始末に追われてばかりだ。\nくそっ
traducao: Thanks to that, I'm always stuck\ncleaning up after his messes.\nDamn it!

original: ルークはそういうところ、\nあんまり気にしてないみたい\nだもんね……
traducao: Luke doesn't really seem\nto care about that kind of thing\nat all, does he......

original: 気にしてないなんて次元じゃねえ。\n大体あいつは……
traducao: It's way beyond not caring.\nIn the first place, that guy......

original: もしかして……
traducao: Could it be......

original: スイッチ入れちゃった……かも？
traducao: Did we... flip his switch?

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
